g.text: PK primary key | UK unique index | REF application reference
Crow foot with circle = zero or many | Bar with circle = zero or one
Every collection includes createdAt and updatedAt timestamps.
User roles share one collection. Role-specific links are combined for readability.
hiddenFor contains user references for per-user visibility; it is not a deletion.
References are checked in application code, not database-enforced foreign keys.
